camel_example: aliyun pvtz DescribeZones --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceTag.1.Value daily --PageSize 20 --Keyword test --ResourceGroupId 'rg-aekz2qj7awz0000' --ZoneTag.1 BLINK --PageNumber 1 --QueryRegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --QueryVpcId 'vpc-f8zvrvr1payllgz380000' --ResourceTag.1.Key env --Lang en --SearchMode EXACT --ZoneType AUTH_ZONE
description_en: You can call the DescribeZones operation to query a list of zones available to your account

kebab_example: aliyun pvtz describe-zones --lang en --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --keyword test --search-mode EXACT --query-region-id cn-hangzhou --query-vpc-id vpc-f8zvrvr1payllgz380000 --resource-group-id rg-aekz2qj7awz0000 --zone-type AUTH_ZONE --zone-tag BLINK --resource-tag Value=daily Key=env --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeZones

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.

en: English.

Default value: en
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：

zh：中文。

en：英文。

默认值：en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置查询的页码，起始值为 1，默认为 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值100，默认为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The keyword of the zone name. The search is not case-sensitive. You can set the SearchMode parameter to switch between exact search and fuzzy search. The default mode is fuzzy search
parameters.help_zh: Zone名称关键字，不区分大小写。你可通过设置搜索模式（SearchMode）切换为“精确搜索”或“模糊搜索”，默认为“模糊搜索”
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
The search mode. This parameter takes effect only when the Keyword parameter is specified. Valid values:

LIKE: fuzzy search (default)

EXACT: exact search

Default value: LIKE
parameters.help_zh:
搜索模式（作用于Keyword参数）。取值：

LIKE：模糊搜索（默认）
EXACT：精确搜索

默认值：LIKE
parameters.name: search_mode

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the VPC that is associated with the zone
parameters.name: query_region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC that is associated with the zone
parameters.name: query_vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the zone belongs
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the zones to query. Valid values:

AUTH_ZONE: authoritative zones.

CLOUD_PRODUCT_ZONE: zones for cloud services.

Default value: AUTH_ZONE
parameters.help_zh:
Zone查询类型。取值：

AUTH_ZONE: 查权威Zone列表。
CLOUD_PRODUCT_ZONE:使用的云产品Zone列表。

默认： AUTH_ZONE
parameters.name: zone_type

parameters.help_en: The list of cloud service types
parameters.name: zone_tag

fields.help_en: The key of the resource tag
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the resource tag
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The resource tags that are added to the zone
parameters.name: resource_tag

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned data

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request

TotalItems.description_en: The total number of entries returned

TotalPages.description_en: The total number of pages returned

items.description_en: The details of a zone object

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the zone was created

CreateTimestamp.description_en: The time when the zone was created. This value is a UNIX timestamp

CreatorSubType.description_en:
The type of the account. Valid values:

CUSTOMER: Alibaba Cloud account

SUB: RAM user

STS: role assumption

OTHER: other
CreatorSubType.description_zh:
账号类型。说明：
CUSTOMER：主账号
SUB：子账号
STS：角色扮演
OTHER：其他

DnsGroup.description_en:
The built-in authoritative location zone. Valid values:

NORMAL_ZONE: regular zone

FAST_ZONE: fast zone
DnsGroup.description_zh:
内置权威位置区。说明：

NORMAL_ZONE：普通区
FAST_ZONE：快速区

DnsGroupChanging.description_en:
The status of the zone migration.

true: The zone is being migrated.

false: The zone is not being migrated
DnsGroupChanging.description_zh:
Zone切换位置区状态。

true：切换中
false：未切换

IsPtr.description_en:
Indicates whether the zone is a reverse lookup zone. Valid values:

true: The zone is a reverse lookup zone.

false: The zone is not a reverse lookup zone
IsPtr.description_zh:
是否为反解zone。说明：

true：是反解zone
false：非反解zone

ProxyPattern.description_en:
Indicates whether the recursive proxy feature is enabled for subdomains. Valid values:

ZONE: The recursive proxy feature is disabled. When you resolve a subdomain that does not exist in the current zone, an NXDOMAIN error is returned.

RECORD: The recursive proxy feature is enabled. When you resolve a subdomain that does not exist in the current zone, the system queries the forwarding and recursion modules and uses the final result to respond to the DNS request
ProxyPattern.description_zh:
是否开启子域名递归代理。说明：
ZONE: 关闭（当解析本域名下不存在的子域名时，直接返回NXDOMAIN，表示子域名不存在）
RECORD: 开启（当解析本域名下不存在的子域名时，会依次查询“转发”和“递归”模块，并以最终查询到的解析结果来应答解析请求）

RecordCount.description_en: The number of DNS records in the zone

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the zone belongs

ResourceTag.description_en: The list of resource tags that are added to the zone

Key.description_en: The key of the resource tag

Value.description_en: The value of the resource tag

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the zone was last updated

UpdateTimestamp.description_en: The time when the zone was last updated. This value is a UNIX timestamp

ZoneId.description_en: The unique ID of the zone

ZoneTag.description_en:
The type of the cloud service.

This parameter is empty if ZoneType is set to AUTH_ZONE.

This parameter indicates the type of the cloud service if ZoneType is set to CLOUD_PRODUCT_ZONE
ZoneTag.description_zh:
云产品类型。

若ZoneType为权威zone，则此为空；
若ZoneType为云产品zone，则此为云产品类型

ZoneType.description_en:
The type of the zone. Valid values:

AUTH_ZONE: authoritative zone.

CLOUD_PRODUCT_ZONE: PrivateZone for a cloud service
ZoneType.description_zh:
Zone类型。说明：

AUTH_ZONE: 权威Zone。
CLOUD_PRODUCT_ZONE: 云产品PrivateZone
